title: Eats hottest pepper
description: Brother eats hottest pepper, sets off fire alarm.

title: Can't feel pain
description: Brother can't feel pain, so we swing a bat on his head.

title: Sneeze causes chaos
description: Holds in a sneeze for 3 days, finally sneezes, small earthquake erupts.

title: Almost got into a fight
description: Brother tried to fight me, but my cold stare became literal.

title: Basketball breaks wall
description: Bully tells brother that he can't play basketball, throws the ball through the wall.

title: Stole brother's lunch
description: Bully stole brother's lunch, eats mystery meat, grows to insane size, bully is scared.

title: Food fight
description: Bully throws meatball at brother, catches it on the fork, throws it back, bounces off all tables.

title: Dodge the Dogdgeball
description: Bully throws dodgeball at brother, ball stops mid air before hitting him, goes back and chases bully.
